home.title: Indigo Academy West | Primary & High School in Bishkek
home.descr: Indigo Academy West is a private school for boys and girls in Bishkek, Grades 1–12. Singapore maths, robotics, chess and komuz in the timetable, more English with native-speaking teachers, and a Cambridge programme from Grade 7.

hero.lead: A school where children think, create and speak English with confidence. From the first lesson in Grade 1 to the Cambridge programme in Grade 12.

welcome.title: Every child is known, heard and challenged
body: At Indigo Academy West, girls and boys learn side by side in small classes where the teacher has time for every pupil. We believe children learn best when they feel safe, are curious, and are asked to think rather than just to remember.

Our primary school combines the Russian-language programme with the Singapore method of teaching. From Grade 7 our pupils move to the Cambridge programme, and all along the way English is part of every day.

items.d: More English lessons than in most schools, with native-speaking teachers on our staff. Children practise English every day, not only in class.
Primary teachers use the Singapore approach: from objects to pictures to abstract ideas, so pupils truly understand, not just memorise.
Robotics, chess, komuz and other extra subjects are part of the timetable, not an optional extra after school.
Like every Indigo Academy school, we follow each pupil individually: their pace, their strengths and what they need next.

stages.title: Two schools, one path from Grade 1 to Grade 12
stages.body: A single campus for the whole school journey. Pupils move from primary to high school without changing school, friends or values.

items.d: Russian-language programme taught with the Singapore method, extra English, and robotics, chess and komuz in the timetable.
The Cambridge programme, individual attention, strong English and preparation for universities and competitions around the world.

about.title: About Us
about.descr: The story, mission and values of Indigo Academy West, a primary and high school in Bishkek.
about.lead: Indigo Academy West is a school of the Indigo Academy network in Bishkek. Boys and girls study here from Grade 1 to Grade 12.

story.title: An Indigo school for the west of Bishkek
body: Indigo Academy West belongs to Indigo Academy, a network of private schools in Bishkek known for its strong teaching and close attention to every child.

Families asked for a school that combines a solid academic base with modern methods, real English practice and a broader education. Indigo Academy West is our answer: a co-educational school for Grades 1–12, with the Singapore method in primary school and the Cambridge programme from Grade 7.

mission.d: To educate curious, well-mannered and confident young people who think independently, speak several languages and are ready for the world.

vision.d: To be the school families in Bishkek choose when they want a strong education, real English and international opportunities for their children.

director.title: Dear parents and guests
body: Thank you for your interest in Indigo Academy West. Choosing a school is one of the most important decisions a family makes, and we are honoured that you are considering us.

Our teachers know every child by name. They notice when a pupil is ready for a bigger challenge and when they need a little more support. We measure success not only in grades, but in how confidently our pupils think, speak and work with others, in their own language and in English.
I warmly invite you to visit us, to see our lessons and to talk with our team.

items.d: Small classes and teachers who follow each pupil’s progress closely.
More hours of English and native-speaking teachers on our staff.
Robotics, chess and komuz as subjects, building logic, creativity and culture.
The Cambridge programme from Grade 7 and preparation for universities abroad.

network.body: Indigo Academy West shares the experience, teaching methods and teacher development programmes of the Indigo Academy network of schools in Bishkek.

primary.title: Primary School
primary.descr: Primary school at Indigo Academy West: Russian-language programme, the Singapore method, extra English, and robotics, chess and komuz as subjects.
primary.lead: Russian-language classes taught with the Singapore method, more English than in most schools, and robotics, chess and komuz in the weekly timetable.

approach.title: Strong foundations, taught the modern way

items.d: Primary classes follow the Russian-language programme, giving children a solid base in reading, writing and mathematics.
Our teachers are trained in the Singapore approach: pupils discuss, work in pairs and explain their thinking.
Extra English lessons every week so children start speaking early and naturally.
Teachers have time for each child, their questions and their pace.

singapore.title: Understanding first, then speed
singapore.body: The Singapore method, used by schools around the world, teaches children to understand an idea before they memorise rules. Pupils move through three steps:

steps.d: Children touch and move real objects: blocks, counters, cards.
They draw what they did, using models such as the famous “bar model”.
Only then do they write numbers and symbols, now with real understanding.

signature.title: Robotics, chess and komuz are lessons here
signature.body: Unlike other private schools, these subjects are part of the weekly timetable for every primary pupil, alongside further clubs after lessons.

items.d: Building and programming robots: engineering thinking from the first grades.
Logic, focus and planning, and learning to win and lose with dignity.
Playing the national instrument: rhythm, memory and love for Kyrgyz culture.
Art, sport, English speaking club and more, so every child finds their thing.

english.title: More English, from Grade 1
english.body: Our primary pupils have more English lessons than in most schools. The aim is practice: children listen, speak, sing, read and play in English every week, with our English teachers and native English-speaking teachers.

care.title: Every pupil has a plan
body: Teenagers need both challenge and support. Our teachers know each pupil well: their strengths, their gaps and their goals.
Progress is reviewed regularly, extra support is offered where it is needed, and pupils who are ready for more are given more. Parents always know how their child is doing.

admissions.title: Admissions
admissions.descr: How to apply to Indigo Academy West: steps, documents and frequently asked questions.
admissions.lead: We are glad that you are considering Indigo Academy West for your child. Our admissions team will guide you through every step.

items.d: Call or message us on WhatsApp to ask about places in your child’s grade.
Tour the building, see lessons and meet the admissions team.
A friendly conversation for future first graders. From Grade 2, a short assessment in mathematics and English.
Bring the documents from the list below to the school office.
Sign the agreement, receive the uniform information and get ready for the first day.

docs.title: What to prepare
items: Personal file and report card from the previous school (for transfers)
Application form completed at the school office
docs.note: The final list may change. Please confirm it with the school office before your visit.

fees.title: Tuition fees
fees.body: Tuition is set for each academic year. Please contact the admissions office for current fees and payment options.

items.a: We teach Grades 1–12. Primary school is Grades 1–6; middle and high school, with the Cambridge programme, is Grades 7–12.

items.q: Is the school for boys and girls?
items.a: Yes. Indigo Academy West is a co-educational school: boys and girls study together.

items.q: In which language are primary classes taught?
items.a: Primary classes follow the Russian-language programme, with extra English lessons every week and Kyrgyz language lessons.
A way of teaching, especially mathematics, in which children first work with objects, then with pictures and models, and only then with numbers and symbols. It builds real understanding.

items.q: Are robotics, chess and komuz paid extras?
items.a: No, at Indigo Academy West robotics, chess and komuz are part of the timetable. Please ask the office about any additional clubs.

items.q: Do you have native English-speaking teachers?
items.a: Yes. Native English-speaking teachers are part of our teaching staff.
Yes, and we recommend it. Call us to agree a convenient day and time for a personal tour.
